description: Machine-readable Danish vehicle registration tax rates 2026–2029: skalaknæk (brackets), CO2 tiers, bundfradrag and EV/plug-in phase-in (indfasning) percentages per year. Identical to GET https://bildata.io/api/afgift-prognose/rates. 2028–2029 rates are provisional; the 2027 EV phase-in (40 %) follows the 12 Nov 2026 tax agreement, not yet enacted (see agreedNotEnacted).
name: get_afgift_rates
